Welcome to the site dedicated to articles about intelligence constructed from data and algorithms as tools for that.

The articles here cover a range of topics, mostly about statistical and traditional machine learning algorithms, as well as causal inference. The main aim of this site to act as a 'personal but public' notebook serving as a platform to organize my own thoughts around arbitrary chosen topics I'm fascinated by.

I intend to write my notes as structured, well-written articles with the main focus on the understandability, and a desired audience of a general non-technical public.
